arxiv-2205-03693.title: New spin-polarized electron source based on alkali-antimonide photocathode
arxiv-2205-03693.creator: V.S. Rusetsky, V.A. Golyashov, S.V. Eremeev, D.A. Kustov, I.P. Rusinov, T.S. Shamirzaev, A.V. Mironov, A.Yu. Demin, O.E. Tereshchenko
arxiv-2205-03693.description: Abstract New spin-dependent photoemission properties of alkali antimonide semiconductor cathodes are predicted based on the detected optical spin orientation effect and DFT band structure calculations. Using these results, the Na 2 KSb/Cs 3 Sb heterostructure is designed as a spin-polarized electron source in combination with the Al 0.11 Ga 0.89 As target as a spin-detector with spatial resolution.

arxiv-2301-11956.title: On the Connection Between MPNN and Graph Transformer
arxiv-2301-11956.creator: Chen Cai, Truong Son Hy, Rose Yu, Yusu Wang
arxiv-2301-11956.description: Abstract Graph Transformer (GT) recently has emerged as a new paradigm of graph learning algorithms, outperforming the previously popular Message Passing Neural Network (MPNN) on multiple benchmarks. Previous work ( Kim et al. 2022 ) shows that with proper position embedding, GT can approximate MPNN arbitrarily well, implying that GT is at least as powerful as MPNN.

arxiv-2310-14751.title: Efficient and Interpretable Bandit Algorithms
arxiv-2310-14751.creator: Subhojyoti Mukherjee, Ruihao Zhu, Branislav Kveton ∗
arxiv-2310-14751.description: Abstract Motivated by the importance of explainability in modern machine learning, we design bandit algorithms that are efficient and interpretable . A bandit algorithm is interpretable if it explores with the objective of reducing uncertainty in the unknown model parameter.

arxiv-2402-13341.title: Revisiting formation of primordial black holes in a supercooled first-order phase transition
arxiv-2402-13341.creator: Marcos M. Flores, Alexander Kusenko, Misao Sasaki
arxiv-2402-13341.description: Abstract We reexamine production of primordial black holes in a supercooled phase transition. While a mere overdensity associated with a surviving false-vacuum patch does not imply formation of a black hole, it is possible for such a patch to evolve and create a black hole, thanks to the gradient energy stored in the bubble wall.

arxiv-2409-19933.title: CCDepth: A Lightweight Self-supervised Depth Estimation Network with Enhanced Interpretability
arxiv-2409-19933.creator: Xi ZHANG, Yaru XUE, Shaocheng JIA, Xin PEI
arxiv-2409-19933.description: Abstract Self-supervised depth estimation, which solely requires monocular image sequence as input, has become increasingly popular and promising in recent years. Current research primarily focuses on enhancing the prediction accuracy of the models. However, the excessive number of parameters impedes the universal deployment of the model on edge devices.

arxiv-2410-05729.title: Equi-GSPR: Equivariant SE(3) Graph Network Model for Sparse Point Cloud Registration
arxiv-2410-05729.creator: Xueyang Kang, Zhaoliang Luan, Kourosh Khoshelham, Bing Wang
arxiv-2410-05729.description: Abstract Point cloud registration is a foundational task for 3D alignment and reconstruction applications. While both traditional and learning-based registration approaches have succeeded, leveraging the intrinsic symmetry of point cloud data, including rotation equivariance, has received insufficient attention. This prohibits the model from learning effectively, resulting in a requirement for more training data and increased model complexity.

arxiv-2411-06044.title: Thermal lifetime of breathers
arxiv-2411-06044.creator: Juan F. R. Archilla, Jānis Bajārs, Sergej Flach
arxiv-2411-06044.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Juan F. R. Archilla, Jānis Bajārs, Sergej Flach. In this article, we explore the lifetime of localized excitations in nonlinear lattices, called breathers, when a thermalized lattice is perturbed with localized energy delivered to a single site. We develop a method to measure the time it takes for the system to approach equilibrium based on a single scalar quantity, the participation number, and deduce the value corresponding to thermal equilibrium.

pmc-10571362.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Anaplastic thyroid cancer (ATC) is a rare but highly aggressive kind of thyroid cancer. pmc-12706926.description: BackgroundAutophagy is an evolutionarily conserved cellular process that maintains homeostasis. pmc-13088780.title: Factors driving antibiotic use and antimicrobial resistance among college-going students in Bangladesh: a cross-sectional study

pmc-13088780.description: BackgroundAntimicrobial resistance (AMR) represents a significant global health challenge, particularly in resource-limited nations such as Bangladesh, where irrational antibiotic use and weak regulatory enforcement persist. pmc-13223868.title: Dietary Artemisia annua leaf powder modulates intestinal response and cecal microbiota of broiler chickens during peak Eimeria infection

pmc-13223868.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). A study was conducted to evaluate the effects of dietary Artemisia annua leaf powder supplementation on growth performance, intestinal health, and cecal microbiota composition in broiler chickens challenged with mixed Eimeria species. A total of 390 one-day-old Cobb 500 chicks were allocated to 5 treatments with 6 replicates of 13 birds each: a non-challenged control (NC), a challenged control (CC), and three challenged groups supplemented with A. annua leaf powder at 0.15, 0.30, and 0.45 %.

pmc-13541054.creator: Noriyuki Kijima, Haruhiko Kishima
pmc-13541054.description: Background: Tentorial meningioma resection is among the most challenging neurosurgical procedures. Various surgical approaches must be considered, including subtemporal, lateral suboccipital, occipital interhemispheric supratentorial, and supracerebellar transtentorial (SCTT) techniques. However, performing tentorial meningioma resections in the SCTT approach using operative microscopy often requires awkward positioning for the neurosurgeon.
